Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Calen Loreth: 29-year-old man, 178 cm (tall), soft rounded construction with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, skin value band-2-light. Face: heart-shaped face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: asymmetric curl shelf. Wardrobe: tailored-longcoat, specifically a cloth longcoat with a readable waist, split hem, plain underlayer, and fitted shoes; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a wrapped keepsake cord; a patterned collar insert. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
